judgments.en_span: Revenue from the Nordic segment amounted to EUR 92.1 million and revenue from the Canadian segment to EUR 56.5 million, of which EUR 18.4 million was generated in Canadian dollars under long-term power purchase agreements.
judgments.zh_span: Le chiffre d'affaires du segment nordique s'élève à 92,1 millions d'euros et celui du segment canadien à 56,5 millions d'euros, dont 18,4 millions d'euros réalisés en dollars canadiens dans le cadre de contrats d'achat d'électricité de long terme.
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey identical financial information about Nordic and Canadian segment revenues with the same breakdown.

judgments.en_span: Operating expenses were stable at EUR 107.4 million.
judgments.zh_span: Les charges opérationnelles sont stables à 107,4 millions d'euros.
judgments.explanation: Both passages state the same operating expense figure and stability characterization.

judgments.en_span: Depreciation and amortisation increased to EUR 22.9 million following the commissioning of Skagen.
judgments.zh_span: Les dotations aux amortissements augmentent à 22,9 millions d'euros à la suite de la mise en service de Skagen.
judgments.explanation: Both passages report the same depreciation and amortisation figure and its cause (Skagen commissioning).

judgments.en_span: The Group had 84,000,000 shares outstanding as at 30 June 2026 and cash and cash equivalents of EUR 63.0 million.
judgments.zh_span: Le Groupe comptait 84 000 000 actions en circulation au 30 juin 2026 et une trésorerie de 63,0 millions d'euros.
judgments.explanation: Both passages provide identical information on outstanding shares and cash equivalents as of the same date.
